question: Fill in the blank (5) with the appropriate word from the options below:
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**fit**" means in good health, especially because of regular physical activity. (स्वस्थ)
 
• The passage emphasizes the importance of staying healthy and physically active.
 
• The other options: "**pertinent**," "**competent**," and "**shape**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is ''**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Staying fit__ and active can enhance both physical and mental well-being.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Pertinent (उपयुक्त)**: relevant or applicable to a particular matter.
 
• **Competent (कुशल)**: having the necessary ability, knowledge, or skill to do something successfully.
 
• **Shape (आकार)**: the external form or appearance characteristic of someone or something.
